purpose: Pre-registration for the single-cell G4 validation of the two currently testable ICLR hero claims (sparse Arm-A top1 production speed; learned top2 conditional compute). Frozen before the G4 run; the harness verifies these fingerprints and thresholds at runtime.
repo_commit_note: Commit containing the frozen harness (scripts/g4_hero_claim_validation.py). The contract is written immediately after; a later contract commit is allowed and the harness records the actual HEAD it ran at.

harness.hash_mode: sha256 of text content with CRLF normalized to LF
harness.selftest: SELFTEST_PASS=true locally (CPU/tiny, torch 2.10.0+cpu, py3.12): model construction for dense/routed/learned, tiny fwd+bwd finite grads for all arms, learned route R0-R6 gates, unselected-expert zero-grad gate, straight-through proxy, update-glue bitwise-equal to opt.model_ref.full_update, report/verdict logic

arm_a.executable_source_of_truth: reference/arm_a_timing_cell_colab.py; local executable stack opt/model_ref.py + opt/model_opt.py + opt/scan_attn.py
arm_a.production_execution: opt3c_all_b1024: branch-free packed state update, zero-carry skip, paper_y direct layout, cached RoPE phase; no checkpoint; dense coordinator; compiled

arm_b.evidence: campaigns/ARM_BC_SEMANTICS.md (committed fbf270a): exhaustive repository search found no Arm-B definition, source, config, checkpoint or ledger entry. The separate modern Transformer control in context/transformer_control_context.json is explicitly not named Arm-B/C.

routed_expert_executor.summary: Routed expert executor (E1, head-shared, compacted active experts); DOE round-0 top1 4.62x, cyclic-window top2 2.89x same-session vs Arm-A

clean_doe_round1.summary: Clean Round-1 DOE, per-config process isolation, capacity-padding intervention: top1 3.2-3.7x, top2 2.5-2.7x, top4 1.4x; residual runtime model T = 30 ms + 0.0575 ms/(Kactive/head)

learned_router.summary: Learned cyclic-window router, straight-through proxy (forward exactly hard), R0-R6 gates pass, graph_breaks=0, 2.38x same-session vs Arm-A at minimum capacity (fixed ref 2.40x)

microbatch_geometry.summary: Microbatch geometry at constant global batch 64x2048: sparse mb2 46.7k tok/s (4.22x best-feasible), dense mb2 thrash, mb1 anomaly resolved

dense_execution_stack.summary: opt3c_all production execution (bitwise/exact, verified); certified packed anchor 69,183 tok/s / 1894.56 ms / 62.55 GiB on G4

sparse_top1.semantic_status: declared sparse Arm-A executor; executor exact relative to the declared sparse architecture; all-active expertized execution recovers dense Arm-A

fixed_top2.semantic_status: declared sparse Arm-A executor (top2 control for router-overhead comparison)

learned_top2.route: per-route-group argmax window, once per forward, straight-through proxy (forward exactly hard)
learned_top2.semantic_status: declared sparse Arm-A architecture change; not dense Arm-A; no claim of dense equivalence

sparse_top1_same_session_speedups.label: MEASURED on RTX 4060 Laptop 8GB (local ranking only; never extrapolated to G4)

dense_g4_anchor.geometry: B16x4, global 64 sequences, T=2048, frozen packed corpus
dense_g4_anchor.label: MEASURED on G4 (direct)

selected_hero_claims.claim: Sparse Arm-A top1 (M8/Ke512, fixed cyclic window, G=128, exact capacity, compiled production stack) reaches >=350,000 packed input tokens/s at global batch 64 x T2048 on G4, measured in the same session as the dense opt3c_all reference over the same frozen-corpus sequence range.
selected_hero_claims.falsified_if: best sparse packed tok/s < 350,000, or any hard correctness gate fails, or the dense/session controls drift beyond 5%
selected_hero_claims.does_not_claim: It is not dense Arm-A. The executor is exact relative to the declared sparse architecture; all-active expertized execution recovers dense Arm-A. No 2.5B training run is executed.
selected_hero_claims.evidence_grade_on_pass: MEASURED (direct G4); 2.5B runtime projection is INFERRED; training/quality consequences are SPECULATIVE

selected_hero_claims.claim: Learned top2 hard routing (M8/Ke512 learned cyclic window, straight-through proxy, inactive experts physically skipped) retains a large production speedup on G4 while adding negligible overhead relative to fixed top2 at the same microbatch geometry (B16x4).
selected_hero_claims.falsified_if: router_overhead > 15% or learned speedup vs dense < 1.5x

not_selected.arm_b: BLOCKED_BY_MISSING_CANONICAL_SPEC - omitted from the G4 cell
not_selected.arm_c: BLOCKED_BY_MISSING_CANONICAL_SPEC - omitted from the G4 cell
not_selected.capacity_padding: killed locally (results/doe_round1_sweep.json): padding is causal but avoidable with exact balanced capacity
not_selected.width_subdivision: killed locally (results/onehour_active_width.json): M16/M32 collapse; champion saturated at M8
not_selected.oscillator_flags_O1_O2: not promoted: no learning-quality evidence in the current campaign; systems-only claims

benchmark_protocol.session: one G4 Colab session, one process per config (compile-contamination rule), fresh model and fresh compile per config
benchmark_protocol.randomized_order: probe set {dense B16, sparse_top1 B8, sparse_top1 B16, sparse_top1 B32} shuffled with recorded seed; adaptive extras, Hero-2 pair, drift control and OOM census appended deterministically
benchmark_protocol.cold_start: fresh runtime; no torch import in the cell before the harness subprocess
benchmark_protocol.microbatch_geometries: B4x16, B8x8, B16x4, B32x2, B64x1 (global 64 sequences)
benchmark_protocol.adaptive_rule: probe B8/B16/B32; run B64 if B32 is best; run B4 if B8 is best
benchmark_protocol.timing: CUDA-synchronized wall time around a complete update: H2D input transfer, on-device mask build, forward, CE (valid targets only), backward, grad clip, fused AdamW step; median and p10/p90
benchmark_protocol.lr_schedule: certified warmup (peak 1e-3, 10M tokens), identical for all arms
benchmark_protocol.corpus_verification: FROZEN.json + corpus_manifest.json + artifact_hashes.json digests and all shard file sizes (fast_verify=True skips per-shard SHA-256); fail closed on mismatch
benchmark_protocol.corpus_usage: 13 distinct 64-row packed batches per config (3 warmups + 10 measured), starting at sequence 0; no replay; cross-sequence lookahead targets and masked padding as produced by training/FrozenPackedCorpus
benchmark_protocol.quality_gates: CPU tiny fp64/fp32 oracles (all-active equivalence, sparse semantics oracle, document-boundary leak, unselected-expert zero grad, learned R0-R6); GPU production-shape all-active equivalence fp32/bf16 (logits, loss, mapped gradients); graph-break counts for dense/top1/top2/learned; repeated-forward determinism; packed boundary no-leak at production T; corpus contract probe
benchmark_protocol.abort_policy: environment, repo fingerprints and corpus contract hard-fail; correctness gates hard-fail and skip benchmarks; graph/determinism recorded
benchmark_protocol.session_stability: dense B16 drift control in a fresh process after all candidates; |drift| > 5% marks the session unstable and blocks FINAL_G4_VALIDATION_PASS

expected_thresholds.final_pass_rule: all hard gates pass AND (HERO_1 PASS or HERO_2 PASS) AND session stable

evidence_labels.MEASURED: direct G4 result produced by the cell
evidence_labels.INFERRED: 2.5B runtime projection from measured full-update throughput; no 2.5B run executed
evidence_labels.SPECULATIVE: expected training/quality consequences; not part of this contract

contract_maintenance: If any fingerprinted file changes, regenerate this contract (harness_sha256 and fingerprints) before the G4 run; the harness fails closed otherwise.
